title: The Imperfective Paradox in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2601.09373v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Do Large Language Models (LLMs) genuinely grasp the compositional semantics of events, or do they rely on surface-level probabilistic heuristics? We investigate the Imperfective Paradox, a logical phenomenon where the past progressive aspect entails event realization for activities (e.g., running $\to$ ran) but not for accomplishments (e.g., building $\nrightarrow$ built). We introduce ImperfectiveNLI, a diagnostic dataset designed to probe this distinction across diverse semantic classes. Evaluating state-of-the-art open-weight models, we uncover a pervasive Teleological Bias: models systematically hallucinate completion for goal-oriented events, even overriding explicit textual cancellation. Prompting interventions partially reduce this bias but trigger a calibration crisis, causing models to incorrectly reject valid entailments for atelic verbs. translated_title: 大语言模型中的未完成体悖论
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）是否真正掌握了事件的组合语义，还是仅仅依赖表层的概率启发式规则？我们研究了“未完成体悖论”（Imperfective Paradox）这一逻辑现象：过去进行时对于活动类动词（如“正在跑步”→“跑了”）蕴含事件已然实现，但对于达成类动词（如“正在建造”→“建成了”）则不作此蕴含。我们引入了ImperfectiveNLI，一个旨在跨多种语义类别探测这一区别的诊断数据集。通过评估最先进的开放权重模型，我们发现了一种普遍存在的“目的性偏差”：模型会系统性地为面向目标的事件臆想出完成结果，甚至会覆盖文本中明确的取消表述。提示干预能在部分程度上减轻这种偏差，却会引发“校准危机”，导致模型错误地拒绝无终体（atelic）动词的有效蕴含关系。表征分析进一步表明，尽管内部嵌入通常能够区分……
tldr: 该论文提出ImperfectiveNLI诊断数据集，揭示了大语言模型在未完成体悖论上普遍存在的“目的性偏差”——模型会系统性地臆想目标导向事件的完成结果、甚至无视文本中明确的取消表述，而提示干预虽能缓解该偏差却会引发校准危机、导致模型错误拒绝无终体动词的有效蕴含。
en_tdlr: Introducing the ImperfectiveNLI diagnostic dataset, this paper uncovers a pervasive Teleological Bias in LLMs—systematically hallucinating the completion of goal-oriented events even when explicitly cancelled—and shows that prompting interventions mitigate this bias only at the cost of a calibration crisis on atelic entailments.
